title: Captain America and the round shield.
lines: Long ago a boy lived in New York.
His name was Steve.
Steve was small and thin.
He was often ill.
But Steve had a big heart.
When someone was being bullied, he always came to help.
Even when the bully was much bigger.
Steve wanted to be a soldier and protect people.
But they said: You're too small.
Then a clever doctor came along.
He saw how brave Steve was.
You have the heart of a hero, said the doctor.
The doctor gave Steve a special drink.
Steve went into a big machine.
The light flashed.
Zoom!
When Steve came out, he was big and very strong.
He could run fast and jump high.
Steve got a blue suit with a white star.
And a round shield.
The shield was red, white and blue.
The shield was very special.
It couldn't break.
When Steve threw it, it flew around and came back.
Whoosh!
From then on Steve was called Captain America.
One day Captain America heard someone shouting.
Help!
Help!
A school bus was on a bridge.
The bridge was creaking.
There were children in the bus.
Captain America ran as fast as he could.
He held the bus with his strong arms.
A piece of the bridge fell down.
Captain America held his shield above the children.
The stones bounced off it.
Tock, tock!
It's all right, he told the children.
I'm here with you.
He slowly pushed the bus back onto the road.
Everyone was safe.
A little girl looked at him.
Aren't you scared?
she asked.
Captain America laughed.
Everyone is scared sometimes.
Being brave means you help anyway.
The girl gave him a hug.
Thank you, Captain America!
Captain America waved his shield.
Remember this, he called.
You don't have to be the strongest.
If you're good to others, you're a hero too.
The end.
